Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished realistic watercolor
educational illustration sheet for a Korean beginner VIOLA textbook, 2 by 2
panels with wide white gutters and white background, no text. Top left: adult
woman standing with a natural balanced posture holding a wooden viola on her
LEFT collarbone, instrument extends to her left, RIGHT hand holds a bow resting
mid bow on strings, viewed from front three-quarter. Top right: same adult seated
upright on firm chair feet flat, with viola held on left collarbone, clearly visible
larger viola and relaxed shoulders. Bottom left: still life of a wooden viola and
viola bow lying safely in an open fitted case, no violin E string detail. Bottom right:
beautiful close view of viola body bridge fingerboard strings scroll, no person.
Precisely four strings, normal instrument proportions, no extra fingers, no labels
or musical notes. These illustrations are atmosphere and posture aids only, hand
technique will be provided separately by verified vector diagrams. Warm amber
wood, teal muted clothing, soft neutral studio light, clear generous margins.
